personal.title: Design Technologist
personal.longStatement:
I spend my time where problems actually happen — on the floor, in the field, alongside the people doing the work — rather than waiting for it to show up in a report. Using AI, I can go from an open question to a working, validated prototype in days instead of months, which means leadership gets to act on evidence instead of assumptions.

Design is one of the tools I bring to that work, not the whole of what I do.
personal.shortStatement: I'm an organizational strategist who uses design, AI, and technology to reduce uncertainty and turn field-level friction into evidence leaders can act on.
